Interactive analysis app

Source: R/app_ui.R
launch_app.Rd

launch_app() opens an interactive interface to flexCountReg in a web browser, with a tab for each step: load data (a bundled example or a CSV file) and create new variables (logs, powers, standardized values, indicators, products, ratios, categories, factors); specify and estimate count regression (countreg()), random-parameter (countreg_rp()), random-effects panel (renb(), poisLind.re(), repois(), negmultinom()), finite-mixture and latent-class (countreg_mix(), countreg_lc()) models; check their numerical status; diagnose them (rootograms, randomized quantile residuals, CURE plots); compare fits; compute predictions, confidence or prediction intervals and tolerance intervals for a table of scenarios; and download the analysis.

Usage

launch_app(..., max_upload_mb = 50)

app_object(max_upload_mb = 50)

Arguments

...

arguments passed to shiny::runApp(), such as port or launch.browser.

max_upload_mb

largest CSV file that can be uploaded, in megabytes.

Value

launch_app() runs the app (it returns when the app is closed). app_object() returns the app as a shiny.appobj, for deployment or testing.

Details

Everything the app runs is compiled into R code that calls the package's functions, evaluated from that code, and appended to a session script: data loading, new variables, fits, diagnostics, predictions and comparisons, in order. The "R code" panel at the bottom shows the session script (and the code of the model being built), and the Export tab downloads it as analysis.R, which reproduces the whole session without the app. Column names and typed values enter the code only as names, numbers or strings, never as code. Models are estimated in background R processes, so the interface stays responsive and long fits can be canceled. Data, fits and jobs belong to one browser session and are removed when it ends; uploaded data are read as CSV only and stay on your computer.

The app needs the packages shiny, bslib, DT, callr, jsonlite and zip (suggested, not required, by flexCountReg); launch_app() offers to install any that are missing.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  launch_app()
}
